title: Vocation
statement: We're exploring the transition from work to vocation.
description: Moving from working to make a living toward doing what we feel called to do.

title: Compassion
statement: Recognizing our shared unconsciousness and seeing beyond ego, judgment, and division.

title: We have to connect with reality.
statement: Freedom means little if we remain disconnected from the world around us. We can't discover our vocation simply by imagining what might give our lives meaning.
